minimalModels.title: Minimal model config
minimalModels.desc: minimal model config (~/.minimal/agent/models.json): providers, their models, and the default. API keys go to a separate credentials file, never into models.json.
minimalModels.apiKeyDesc: The key literal is written per provider into minimal's credential file (~/.minimal/agent/.credentials.json) and read directly by the minimal runtime. It is not injected as a process environment variable nor written into models.json.
minimalModels.name: name
minimalModels.importDesc: Paste JSON (single or array of {provider, apiKeyEnv?, displayName?, api?, baseURL?, models}): existing provider is overwritten, otherwise appended.
minimalModels.importInvalid: Invalid JSON or wrong shape (expected {provider, models:[]})
minimalModels.discoverEmpty: Click "Scan models" to list all models on this endpoint
minimalModels.discoverUseConfigured: Listing not supported · use {{count}} configured models instead
